name: fast-kev-compaction
description: Verbatim Kev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: Kev API key
apiKey.description: Bearer key of your Kev endpoint (the KEV_API_KEY you deployed with). Leave unset to use the KEV_API_KEY environment variable.

baseUrl.title: Kev endpoint URL
baseUrl.description: Required. Full URL of your Kev endpoint, e.g. https://<workspace>--kev-api.modal.run/v1/systemone.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Kev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Kev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Kev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Kev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Kev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Kev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Kev model
model.description: Kev model name served by your endpoint.
